content.title: Sharp Partial Regularity of Weakly Pseudoholomorphic Maps Into Projective Algebraic Varieties
content.abstract: For every $m\geq2$, we prove that a weakly pseudoholomorphic $W^{1,2}_{\mathrm{loc}}$ map from a real-analytic almost complex $2m$-manifold into a projective algebraic variety has a countably $(2m-4)$-rectifiable singular set. When $m=2$, the singular set is shown to be locally finite. We first establish both conclusions on smooth almost complex domains under the additional assumption that the pullback of the Fubini--Study form is distributionally closed. We then show that this conservation law follows from the Cauchy--Riemann equation alone on real-analytic domains.
